doc: The ONE movement and feel tuning file (owner 11-08), read by scripts/core/locomotion.gd (Loco) for the farm avatar and every match hunter alike. Live: with the movement readout open (F7, or Settings > Controls), saving this file re-reads it within poll_s. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; drags are 1/s (the share of the excess lost per second, exponential). air: accel = how hard WASD pushes in the air; counter = multiplier on accel for the part of your speed going against the keys (a backward drift turns forward in ~0.1 s); side = multiplier for the part going across the keys (bends the arc); drag = how fast speed above your run cap (dash, knock, launch) bleeds in the air; idle_drag = what a jump with no keys loses per second. glide (the pull toward where you steer is [game data], HunterMove.glide_accel): turn / turn_fast = deg/s at cruise and the share kept at the max; brake / brake_deg = pulling back past this angle brakes this hard; drag = how fast speed above cruise bleeds with no keys (back to cruise in ~1.5 s), drag_steer = the same while steering; coast = m/s^2 a let-go under cruise slows; catch = m/s^2 the canopy eases a fall to its sink rate (absorbed, never turned into speed; ours: the source clamps the fall the step the glider opens, HunterMove.glide_start_vy, and its fastest-fall half is locked); max = the fastest a glide carries. glide_carry: per hunter, speed above this carried from Shift into a glide bleeds at carry_drag (on top of drag), so a dash never turns into a long sprint. dash.jump_keep: the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps (the rest is air drag's, Loco.air_step; 1 = all of it, a long dash-jump). dash_speed: per hunter, a dash's speed scale (its time stretches so the distance stays); the shape of a dash (ease in, peak, skid) is the hunter's source curve in content/rules/dash_feel.json. buffers: the input windows (s), one line each in buffers.doc.

doc.ability_hold: s: an ability press made mid-dash waits at most this long past the dash's end, and one made this close to a stun, root or Grounded ending goes on the first free step (one window, decision 0022)
doc.recast: s: a recast pressed before its window opens is kept this long and goes the moment it opens
doc.jump: s: a jump pressed this long before you land goes off as you touch down
doc.coyote: s: after running off a ledge you can still jump for this long
doc.shift: s: a Shift pressed while a rush, grapple or pad flight still runs is kept this long and dashes as it ends
doc.juggernaut_heavy: s: Juggernaut only: a Smash or slash pressed this close before a heavy move (Meteor Drop, Warchain pull, dash) ends goes off the moment it ends
